title: PurchaseQuantityRule - Data API
description: Represents a rule that restricts the quantity of a product that can be purchased. The rule can be an increment, minimum, or maximum rule. This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: The ISO code for the currency that’s specified on the buyer’s account. Default value is USD. Possible values are: EUR—Euro USD—U.S. Dollar

Increment.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort, Update
Increment.description: Quantity of product that can be added with each increase.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Maximum.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort, Update
Maximum.description: Maximum quantity that can be purchased.

Minimum.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort, Update
Minimum.description: Minimum quantity that can be purchased.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: Name of the purchase quantity rule.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the creator of this object. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

special_access_rules: The PurchaseQuantityRule object is available only if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.
